## Description

A spherical green alga of 2–10 µm (adults 6–8 µm in liquid culture) with a parietal cup-shaped
chloroplast and a pyrenoid; no flagella or contractile vacuole. It reproduces by autospores: the
mother divides inside its wall into 2–4 (sometimes 8 or 16) daughters released when the wall breaks.
Cardinal temperatures 4.4 / 28.9 / 42.1 °C.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 20 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A non-motile phototroph releasing 4 [autospores](../../mechanics/life-cycle-and-division.md) per cycle. Prey of
*Ochromonas* and many grazers; source of the endosymbionts of *Paramecium bursaria*.

## Not implemented yet

- No predator-induced colonies (Boraas et al. 1998): they arise by selection and need a coloniality
  gene ([signals](../../mechanics/chemical-signals.md#limitations)).
- Variable number of autospores (2–16) is fixed at 4.

## Unique and shared mechanics

Shares autospore reproduction with *Desmodesmus* and *Raphidocelis*; its endosymbiotic form lives in
[*P. bursaria*](../../mechanics/symbioses.md).
